text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just a little! ...Let's include 
Digital-chan too, so it's the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um, sorry if I'm getting the wrong 
idea, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Digital-chan, you were staring at 
Believe-chan the whole time... I was 
wondering if there was something you 
wanted to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Abyababa!? B-B-Busted... I AM SO 
INCREDIBLY SORRYYY!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That was, um... I couldn't help but be 
captivated watching Believe-san shoeing 
horses... I just wanted to catch a glimpse 
of the mindset behind it!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...A code of conduct. I cannot answer 
that.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Oh, does Believe mean we should 
"learn by watching"? Craftsmen are usually 
like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "No. I haven't reached that level yet."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I don't mind if you're just 
looking.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nghh! S-So precious...! Dantsu-san... no, 
O Goddess of Mercy, I thank you from the 
bottom of my heart!
